text:
mike: Heads up — we're seeing a spike in strict fncall schema rejects for a subset of EU-west traffic, and the cost dashboard shows a matching bump in per-token billing when rejects hit the fallback degen route. Anyone else seeing this?
priya: saw it earlier, looks like the validator moved to 'strict' for the new toolhook canary slice last night.
sam: can you paste the dashboard link?
mike: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/cost#slice=eu-west&metric=invoke_rejects
liz: hmm the timeline aligns with the canary rollout at 02:12 UTC. rejects → fallback route increases token counts because we re-run with a cheaper model but longer compensation prompt.
priya: exact log sample: ```WARN fncall: validation failed: expected object but got array -> routing: strict -> fallback: degen-model-v2 -> tokens_charged=342```
jordan: so two problems: (1) validator strictness causing rejects, (2) fallback path adds extra tokens and gets charged. We need a quick mitigation for cost and a longer-term UX fix.
rob: short-term: can we toggle the validator to soft for that canary slice? that should reduce rejects immediately.
priya: I can flip the feature flag for the slice, yes. i'll do a scoped rollback to soft-validate for slice=canary-euw-1 in 5m unless we hear objections.
sam: +1 do that. Also can we tag the rejects in telemetry with route_id and validator_mode so we can break down cost impact? currently dashboard aggregates across routes.
jordan: agreed — we need route_id and validator_mode on the billing metric line. Without that it's hard to decide policy.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0427 — fncall-validation-cost-spike. Assigned: eng-platform. Priority: P2.
priya: turned the flag off for canary-euw-1. monitoring the rejects count and cost line.
mike: noted. after flip, rejects dropped in logs — partial sample: ```INFO fncall: validation passed (soft) -> routed: primary-compact -> tokens_charged=48```
anomaly-bot: metric anomaly detected: invoke_rejects[euw] dropped -78% in 3m following flag change.
rob: good. for longer term: proposal items — (A) dashboard: add breakdown by validator_mode and route_id, (B) in-console UX: warn when strict validate is enabled for a canary that uses a fallback route that re-invokes models, (C) change billing attribution so a single logical request shows combined tokens instead of double-charging when we run a retry/fallback.
liz: (C) is tricky — billing pipeline currently attributes tokens to the actual pipelines run. changing that is a product/finance decision. but we can surface a "combined logical tokens" view as a stopgap.
sam: for (A) here's a quick PromQL suggestion to add to the cost widget: ```sum by(route_id, validator_mode) (increase(invoke_tokens_total[1h]))``` will give per-route, per-validator token churn.
jordan: add a tag `validator_mode` to invoke telemetry in the ingest layer — currently it's omitted for performance reasons, but we should sample it for 10% of traffic to keep overhead low.
priya: i can add sampling and wire the metric, but need an owner for the console tile change. who owns dashboards?
rob: that's me. i'll add a new tile for the combined view and the prom query Sam suggested.
mike: also we should add an alert: if strict-validate rejects cause >5% increase in tokens_charged over baseline within 15m, page eng-platform on-call.
anjordan: small correction: page only after the flag flip fails to reduce rejects (to avoid noise). set alert to 15m sustained.
rob: noted. i'll create the alert as "fncall.strict_rejects_token_increase" with a 15m window.
priya: follow-ups: (1) postmortem draft with root cause (validator config drift + lack of route-level metrics), (2) sampling for validator_mode telemetry, (3) dashboard tile + alert, (4) product discussion about billing attribution. i'll start the PRs.
mike: thanks. can someone add a short blurb to the canary runbook about "strict validate + fallback = potential token re-run" so next time we flip strict on canaries we know to watch cost.
liz: will add to runbook.
sam: also file a UX ticket: when enabling strict validate, console should show "this may cause additional model runs if fallback is enabled" with link to docs.
priya: PRs opened: infra#782 (sampling), console#421 (dashboard tile), runbook#12. I'll ping when deployments are up.
mike: perfect. closing loop — feel free to DM for quick sync. :thumbsup:
